summary: Completed comprehensive testing of NovaVision API updated endpoints according to specification. All 11 backend endpoint tests passed successfully including superadmin login, expense pagination/filtering, new dashboard format, CSV export, user management, and logout functionality.
passed_tests: GET /api/expenses with pagination (page, limit) - tested multiple page sizes
GET /api/expenses with search filter - created test expense and verified search functionality
GET /api/expenses with date range filter (dateFrom, dateTo) - found 4 expenses in range
GET /api/dashboard/summary returns new format (total_month, total_paid, total_pending, overdue_count, by_type)
GET /api/dashboard/upcoming returns overdue/due30/due60 structure - found 3 due30 payments
GET /api/reports/expenses?format=csv exports CSV - 788 characters exported successfully
POST /api/auth/logout invalidates token - verified token becomes invalid after logout
GET /api/users/:id returns single user - retrieved superadmin user details
PUT /api/users/:id updates user - created test user and successfully updated name and role
All CRUD operations working with proper status codes (200 for POST, not 201)
